Addresses in the object start at 0. The source lines are placed from the object’s line-number table. The notes after

program if_then

      implicit none

      integer                   ::      num1
      integer, parameter        ::      num2 = 5

      print *, "Enter a number between 1 and 10 -> "
      read *, num1

      if (num1 > num2) then
              print *, "Number entered greater than 5!"
      end if

end program if_then
is a parameter, so it is the immediate 5 and it has no stack slot.

Each Fortran I/O statement builds a descriptor and calls the runtime.
